Hi Team,

" + "

" + "

Please manually resolve invoice issues or remove customer from spreadsheet before order is completed.

" + "

Code = " + $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.CustomerCode + "
Meds = " + $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.quantity + " x " + $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.ProductNameCleaned + "

" + "

RemainingBalance = " + $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.RemainingBalance + "

" + "

Script URL = " + $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.scriptURL + "

" + "

Profile URL = https://ashleymartinnz.zenoti.com/Guests/GuestProfileV2/GuestProfileV2Wrapper.aspx?Display=True&UserId=" + $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.CustomerID + "

" + "

Invoice = " + $('Check Invoice Exists').item.json.invoice.invoice_number_prefix + $('Check Invoice Exists').item.json.invoice.invoice_number + "

" + "

InvoiceID = " + $('Check Invoice Exists').item.json.invoice.id + "

" + "

Sum Total = $" + $json.invoice.total_price.sum_total + "

" + "

Regards,
Automation.

" }, "toRecipients": [ { "emailAddress": { "address": $('Get row(s)').item.json.email } } ] }, "saveToSentItems": true } }}
